title: Exact spreadsheet answers
intro: Review CSV and XLSX sheets, then enable exact customer answers from their full tables. Upload files in Documents first.
policy: New and reprocessed sheets stay paused until you enable them. Enabled rows are available to customers through read-only queries. Partial spreadsheet chunks are excluded from answer retrieval.
loadError: Spreadsheets could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
actionError: The spreadsheet could not be updated. Refresh and try again.
empty: No spreadsheets yet. Upload a CSV or XLSX in Documents.
needsImport: This older spreadsheet needs reprocessing before exact queries are available.
reimportPrompt: Reprocess this file? Its table access will pause, and you must review and enable the replacement. Normal knowledge processing usage applies.
queryHelp: Use SELECT with the table name and column aliases shown below. COUNT and SUM scan the full table. Queries have a short timeout and limited results; joins, subqueries, writes and system functions are unavailable.
queryError: Query could not be completed. Check the selected columns and supported SQL, or narrow the result. The data may have changed; refresh before retrying.
truncated: The displayed rows are limited. Use COUNT or SUM to calculate totals across the full table.
